thread:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a weird eviction pattern in ap-northeast1 this morning. Small gangs are getting preempted, but large reserved jobs stay.

maria: also saw it. gpu=1 pods evicted repeatedly; eviction_count spikes line up with autoscaler ramps.

jia: is this related to the scheduler roll yesterday? @sam did we touch gang placement?

sam: I rolled a scheduler config at 2026-03-21 05:10 UTC — only tweaked rackAffinity scoring. No gang-lock changes.

alex: logs show allocate failures then immediate preempts. snippet:
```
I0301 05:12:23.123 allocate.go:452] allocate: candidates=3 selected=1 node=gpux-az3 reason=taint-conflict
E0301 05:12:23.124 eviction.go:89] eviction: preempting pod batch/infer-small-123 (gpu=1)
```

maria: NIC util on those nodes hits 95% during the spike, and we saw nvlink errors in dmesg — might be network-induced packing fallout.

jia: my hypothesis: rackAffinity score now outranks binpack, so tiny pods are scattered across racks instead of coalescing; localized pressure causes preempts when warmpool ramps.

sam: I profiled scheduler decision path — found a new `rackAffinityScore` branch evaluated before `binpackScore`. Oops.

alex: mitigation plan: revert rackAffinity ordering temporarily OR add a tiny-pod coalesce policy. Also slow down autoscaler ramp to avoid shock.

maria: spinning up a canary in us-west2 with label `smallpods=coalesce` and applying scheduler tweak now.

sre-bot: Deployment event: rollback-scheduler-config-2026-03-21 initiated by sam (ticket INF-2345)

sam: rolling back in ~10m. will watch eviction_count, queue_length, and NIC errs.

jia: canary results: after rollback eviction rate dropped ~80% in 15m. looks promising.

alex: next steps: run a 100-tiny-pod probe across racks to reproduce; capture scheduler traces + node NIC error logs; add a rule to prefer warmpool coalescing for pods <0.5 GPU.

maria: created INF-2345 with graphs & assign to eng-platform. linking logs and pprof.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
